overview: A red supergiant system used as a Sith staging point during the Great Hyperspace War.
history:
Primus Goluud appears in records spanning the Old Republic, Clone Wars, Imperial era, Galactic Civil War, and Legacy periods. Archaeological surveys, holocrons, and veteran testimony preserve its place in galactic history.

Strategic value, cultural identity, and Force-sensitive traditions on Primus Goluud shifted with each regime—from Sith occupation to Republic restoration and beyond.
significance: Primus Goluud remains a reference point in Outer Rim Territories surveys, trade lane charts, and military campaign planning across the nine saga films, series, KOTOR, and the Old Sith Empire.
notableEvents: Surveyed during the Old Republic expansion into Outer Rim Territories
